tasks.title: Unicode prefix
requirements: Return at most n Unicode code points, preserving complete supplementary characters.

tasks.title: Deadline boundary
requirements: A lease is active only while now is strictly less than its deadline.

tasks.title: Explicit zero setting
requirements: Use default only when setting is null or undefined; preserve zero, false and empty string.

tasks.title: Numeric order
requirements: Return numbers ascending without changing the supplied array.

tasks.title: First occurrence deduplication
requirements: Return distinct values in the order of their first occurrence.

tasks.title: Weighted measurement
requirements: Return sum(value*weight)/sum(weight), null if total weight is zero; inputs use nonnegative finite weights.

tasks.title: Path membership
requirements: For normalized absolute POSIX paths, allow the root itself and descendants, but reject names merely sharing a prefix.

tasks.title: UTC month
requirements: Return a UTC calendar date string YYYY-MM-DD from an epoch millisecond timestamp.

tasks.title: Immutable queue
requirements: Return queue items sorted by priority ascending, preserving caller queue order and object identity.

tasks.title: Integer cents rounding
requirements: Round integer millicents to integer cents, nearest with ties away from zero; inputs are safe small integers.

tasks.title: Half-open overlap
requirements: Two half-open intervals overlap only if they share positive length; touching or empty intervals do not overlap.

tasks.title: Cache freshness
requirements: A cached entry is fresh only before insertedAt+ttl; equality is expired, and ttl zero is immediately expired.

relatedPair.measurement: Run u12 with fresh empty memory and separately after verified u02 reflection, same runtime/model/seed/budget; compare actual inference outcomes and calls. No memory benefit inferred from fixture success.

acceptanceRules: Each unchanged source must produce actual assertion RED before any model attempt.
Only actual admitted local inference may propose changes; no oracle patches or predetermined model answers.
Acceptance tests and task requirements remain fixed.
Run candidate in approved OS isolation, preserve diagnostics and raw transcript hashes.
A contract fixture never counts as an unknown task solved by a model.
